author: Tethium
body:
Hello, i was a OCN's player, but unfortunately they ban me for writing improper words in chat, for that reason I have decided to integrate in this community to play the next tournament.
I was in 4 different teams when I played in OCN:

  • Illusion (top 16, mini event)
  • Arya (top 16, mini event)
  • Arya (top 16, official tournament)
  • SquadCat (top 15, official tournament)
  • Punishers (no tournament)

If someone is interested in me, I'll gladly add it to Skype :)
